task_instance: Write the full set of user-facing UI copy strings for a small 'notifications settings' feature of a fictional product (TaskFlow): page title/body/tooltip/toggle labels/button (Plain Speech), an error message, a confirmation dialog (Plain Speech), and an empty state, loading state, 404 page, and onboarding step (Sentry Voice) -- applying the tone-selection table, Plain Speech rules, Sentry Voice principles, spelling/punctuation/word-choice rules, dash usage, and per-element (buttons/errors/empty states/confirmation dialogs/tooltips) guidance from SKILL.md.
evidence: Produced ui_copy.md containing the requested copy deck. Verified compliance with the guidelines via grep checks run from the work directory: (1) no exclamation marks appear in any actual copy string (only in the explanatory notes section, referring to the rule); (2) none of the banned words 'please', 'sorry', 'oops', or the phrase 'Success!' appear in any delivered copy string; (3) the only occurrence of robot-speak/passive markers ('has occurred', 'were saved') is in the explicitly labeled 'Bad' contrast example, not in the delivered copy, confirming the actual strings use active voice ('Save changes', 'Check your connection and try again') as required. Manually cross-checked each string against SKILL.md rules: Title Case used for the page title ('Notification Settings'), Sentence case for body/labels, no periods on short button labels ('Save changes', 'Cancel', 'Back to dashboard'), periods used on full-sentence help/error text, Sentry Voice reserved for 404/empty-state/loading/onboarding per the tone table, Plain Speech used for settings UI/errors/confirmation per the same table, buttons use specific action verbs within 2-3 words, error message follows the 'what happened / why / what to do' structure, confirmation dialog uses specific button labels instead of 'OK'. This is a pure writing/style task -- no external tools, network access, or credentials were needed, so it was fully achievable within the runtime's file-write and shell capabilities.
